coreIdea: Split collateral into UP+DOWN full sets and symmetrically rest maker asks above mid on both legs, collecting the spread takers pay while the $1 redemption hedges unsold inventory.

experiments.hypothesis: Symmetric maker asks quoted a fixed offset above mid on both legs of a split full set collect more spread than trending-window adverse selection costs, at zero taker fees.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: All cells net-negative, monotone improving with offset: 0.01 -0.58, 0.02 -0.50, 0.03 -0.45, 0.05 -0.28 netEv/mkt (runs 127-130, 1000 mkts each, 1015-1857 trades — volume healthy). Best is the grid EDGE, not a plateau. Gross is negative in every cell (fees only ~$0.003-0.004/mkt — fee-free thesis holds; the loss is pure adverse selection on maker fills). Loss shrinks toward the $0 no-quote limit (split+redeem is EV-neutral), so EV approaches zero FROM BELOW as quoting gets less aggressive — no positive interior in this grid. Weekly chunks uniformly negative at 0.01-0.03 (structural, not regime); 0.05 mixed but net negative. Advisory for later passes: a probe above offset 0.05 may confirm the asymptote-to-zero shape; note worst_queue fills only the adversely-selected flow, so these numbers are the conservative bound.

All cells net-negative, monotone improving with quoteStopSec: 60 -0.34, 120 -0.28, 240 -0.23, 420 -0.15 netEv/mkt (runs 131-134, 1000 mkts each, 655-1075 trades — volume healthy). Best is again the grid EDGE (420s of a 900s window = quote only the first 8 min), not a plateau. Gross negative in every cell (fees $2.3-4.7/1000mkts — loss is adverse selection, not fees). Both weekly chunks negative in every cell (structural, not regime). Same asymptote-to-zero-from-below shape as pass 1: EV shrinks toward the $0 no-quote limit as quoting time shrinks; no positive interior. Consistency check: run 132 (quoteStopSec=120) exactly reproduces pass-1 run 130 (-0.28). Advisory: both knobs swept so far reduce loss only by quoting LESS — early-window quoting is as adversely selected as late; win rate 43-45% with avgWin < avgLoss in every cell. Pass 3's repriceDelta=1 (never reprice) is the last mechanistically distinct cell that could behave differently; sizeUsd (pass 4) is a linearity check and cannot flip sign.

All cells net-negative; direction REVERSES vs passes 1-2 — more repricing helps: 0.01 -0.10, 0.02 -0.15, 0.04 -0.26, 1 (never) -0.53 netEv/mkt (runs 135-138, 1000 mkts each, 502-1485 trades). Never-reprice is decisively worst: win rate 65.8% but avgWin 1.44 vs avgLoss -4.46 — stale asks sell cheap into every trend (pennies-vs-steamroller). Tracking the mid at 0.01 cuts adverse selection to -0.10, the family's best cell so far, but gross is still negative in every cell and both weekly chunks negative everywhere (W23 at 0.01 is -0.01, near break-even, W24 -0.16). Best is again a grid EDGE (0.01 = tightest sweep value; sub-0.01 thresholds are possible since mids move sub-cent). Consistency check: run 135 (repriceDelta=0.02) exactly reproduces run 134 (-0.15). Advisory: pass 3 answered its mechanistic question — the last distinct cell (never-reprice) did NOT flip the sign, it confirmed stale quotes are the dominant loss channel. Picture after 3 passes: every knob's best is quote-less/track-faster and EV approaches $0 from below; only pass 4 (sizeUsd linearity check, cannot flip sign) remains before the gate-1 verdict.

Linearity confirmed — per-dollar EV is flat and negative: 5 -0.05, 10 -0.10, 20 -0.18 netEv/mkt ≈ -$0.010 per $ of size (runs 141/139/140, 1000 mkts each, 495-515 trades, identical 401 played and ~46.4% win rate — size changes only the stake, not the behavior). Argmax 5 is just smallest-stake-loses-least; the param is a pure scale knob — flat per-dollar, don't spend more passes on it. Gross negative in all cells; both weekly chunks negative in all cells (W23 -0.01 everywhere, near break-even; W24 carries the loss). Consistency check: run 139 (sizeUsd=10) exactly reproduces run 138 (-0.10).

gateLog.note: Gate 1 failed: best cell netEv -0.05/mkt (run 141) < 0 at 1000-market coverage. Advisories: gross negative in every cell of all 4 passes (fees $0.7-7.6/1000mkts — loss is adverse selection, never fees); both weekly chunks negative in every cell (structural, not regime); all four knobs' best values sit at grid edges pointing toward quote-less/track-faster, EV approaching the $0 no-quote limit from below with no positive interior.

outcome.reason: Best cell (offset 0.05, quoteStopSec 420, repriceDelta 0.01, sizeUsd 5; run 141) nets -0.05/mkt over 1000 markets (495 trades, gross -0.048, fees $2.16 total) — successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' not met; all 15 cells across 4 coordinate passes are net- and gross-negative.

experiments.hypothesis: The baseline's measured loss channel is the surviving leg going stale after the first fill (pass 3: never-reprice -0.53 vs fastest-tracking -0.10). Requoting the survivor at the NEW mid plus a reduced completion offset the moment one leg sells completes the pair and banks offset+completionOffset before the trend runs away, cutting adverse selection below zero where static tracking (best cell -0.05/mkt, run 141) could not.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: All cells net-negative, monotone WORSE as completion gets more aggressive: 0 -0.13, 0.01 -0.12, 0.02 -0.10, 0.05 -0.05 netEv/mkt (runs 146/143/144/145, 1000 mkts each, 495-804 trades — volume healthy). completionOffset 0.05 equals the entry offset, so that cell degenerates to the baseline (run 145 reproduces run 141 exactly: net -0.05, gross -0.0478, fees 2.16, 495 trades, 46.38% win) — the argmax is 'mechanism off'. Win-rate gradient is the tell: 1.25% at co=0 (avgWin 0.07), 19% at 0.01, 38% at 0.02, 46% at 0.05 — completing the pair sells the survivor at its ALREADY-FALLEN mid, realizing the adverse move that hold-to-redemption leaves as an open reversion bet; the banked premium (offset+co per completed set) never covers it. Gross negative in every cell; both weekly chunks negative in every cell (structural). No refinement requested: the response is monotone toward mechanism-off, so no positive interior exists in this direction.

gateLog.note: Gate 1 failed: best cell netEv -0.05/mkt (run 145, degenerate = baseline behavior) < 0 at 1000-market coverage; best cell where completion actually acts is -0.10 (co=0.02). Advisory: hypothesis refuted in direction, not just magnitude — requoting the survivor cheaper monotonically ADDS loss; selling the fallen leg realizes adverse selection the baseline's hold-to-redemption partially recovers. Roadmap ideas that REDUCE post-fill exposure (inventory stop) remain untested; ideas that increase survivor selling pressure should be deprioritized.

outcome.reason: Best cell (completionOffset 0.05 = degenerate baseline; run 145) nets -0.05/mkt over 1000 markets (495 trades, gross -0.048) — successCriteria 'Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1)' not met; every cell where the completion mechanism acts is strictly worse than the baseline (-0.10 to -0.13 vs -0.05).

experiments.hypothesis: 000/001 jointly measured that survivor fills are negative contributors (keep quoting the survivor: -0.05; sell it faster: -0.10 to -0.13). Cancelling the surviving leg's ask the moment the first leg fills and holding it to the $1-redemption hedge removes those fills entirely, so it should strictly improve on -0.05/mkt (run 141); re-arming only when the survivor's mid returns near 0.5 additionally collects premium in reverted (uncertain) books without selling into the trend.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).
